name: gc-collectable-root-scope-limits
body: Unit reachability is ref-based `(rel, oid)` only, and every stored scaffolding row roots its body, so a unit under a superseded format/config digest that still matches a live ref survives, and a superseded config-digest's scaffolding row is never retired. The leak is bounded (one scaffolding body per language x config) and costs store growth, never a wrong fact; upgrade when store growth across config changes must be reaped, by scoping units and scaffolding to the live worktree's current cache key.
